SELECT
    '{{ $json.N_Facture }}'          AS N_Facture,
  '{{ $json.CodeFrs }}' as CodeFrs,
  '{{ $json.BLFrs }}' as BLFrs,
  '{{ $json.DateBC }}' as DateBC,
  '{{ $json.N_BC }}' as N_BC,
  '{{ $json.CodeArticle }}' as CodeArticle,
  '{{ $json.Quantite }}' as Quantite,
  '{{ $json.N_B_transport }}' as N_B_transport,
  '{{ $json.Matricule }}' as Matricule,
  '{{ $json.Poids }}' as Poids,
  '{{ $json.Marque }}' as Marque,
  '{{ $json.observation }}' as observation,
'{{ $json.email_expediteur }}' as email_expediteur,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(p.XNFACT_0) > 0 THEN 'EXISTE' ELSE 'INEXISTANT' END AS status,
    COUNT(p.XNFACT_0)                     AS nb_lignes
FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) d
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PRECEIPT p
       ON p.XNFACT_0 = '{{ $json.N_Facture }}'

select 
  '{{ $json.N_Facture }}'   AS N_Facture,
  '{{ $json.CodeFrs }}' as CodeFrs,
  '{{ $json.BLFrs }}' as BLFrs,
  '{{ $json.DateBC }}' as DateBC,
  '{{ $json.N_BC }}' as N_BC,
  '{{ $json.CodeArticle }}' as CodeArticle,
  '{{ $json.Quantite }}' as Quantite,
  '{{ $json.N_B_transport }}' as N_B_transport,
  '{{ $json.Matricule }}' as Matricule,
  '{{ $json.Poids }}' as Poids,
  '{{ $json.Marque }}' as Marque,
  '{{ $json.observation }}' as observation,
  '{{ $json.email_expediteur }}' as email_expediteur
  from  BASE1.XREGNLR
where BPCNUM_0='{{ $json.CodeFrs }}' and  NETAP_0 <> 0
